taglineZh: 从命名、目录到 Vue/React 与 Git 的团队统一规范
taglineEn: Team-wide rules from naming and folders to Vue/React and Git
descZh: 一套企业级前端开发规范，覆盖目录结构、命名、HTML/CSS/JS/TS、Vue 与 React 写法、Git 提交、ESLint 配置、性能与安全共 12 章。适合团队统一代码风格或新项目起步时逐条对照，产出是可直接落地的条款清单。
descEn: An enterprise frontend spec in 12 chapters: folder structure, naming, HTML/CSS/JS/TS, Vue and React conventions, Git commits, ESLint setup, performance and security. Use it to align a team's code style or bootstrap a new project; output is a ready-to-adopt rule list.
demoCaptionZh: 规范文档示例页：目录导航加条款排版与代码示例
demoCaptionEn: A sample spec document with TOC, clause typography and code examples

taglineZh: 用硬性底线和抽主题让页面像设计过的，不像生成的
taglineEn: A hard floor and dealt themes make pages look designed, not generated
descZh: 为新页面定下不可妥协的底线：颜色字体全走 token、禁 transition:all、禁编造数据和 logo 墙，再抽一个主题方向避免连续产出趋同。适合让 AI 生成的落地页摆脱模板味，产出是完整页面、tokens.css 和 lint 检查记录。
descEn: Sets a non-negotiable floor for new pages: tokenized color and type, no transition:all, no invented metrics or logo walls, then deals a theme so consecutive builds don't converge. Use it to keep AI-built landing pages off the template path; output is a full page plus tokens.css and a lint log.
demoCaptionZh: 一个按 Hallmark 底线构建的编辑感页面片段：首屏主张加工序卡
demoCaptionEn: An editorial page fragment built under Hallmark's floor: hero claim plus a process card

taglineZh: 缓动配方、动画词汇与性能约束的动效判断库
taglineEn: Easing recipes, motion vocabulary and performance constraints
descZh: 提供动效总则、缓动与配方、动画性能排查和苹果风格组件细节，共 31 份按需加载的参考文件。给交互补动效、判断该不该动、或定位动效卡顿原因时使用，产出是动效配方与实现约束，不负责组装整页。
descEn: Motion principles, easing recipes, animation performance debugging and Apple-style component details across 31 load-on-demand references. Use it to add motion to an interaction, decide whether it should move at all, or diagnose jank; output is recipes and implementation constraints, not full pages.
demoCaptionZh: 一组讲究缓动与时长、真实可点的微交互：按钮、开关、弹出层与列表入场
demoCaptionEn: Clickable micro-interactions with deliberate easing: button, switch, popover and staggered list

taglineZh: 把动效需求写成字段化、可复用的提示词模板
taglineEn: Turn motion needs into field-based, reusable prompt templates
descZh: 定义动效提示词的格式约定与字段拆解，并示范把参考图转写成提示词。想让 AI 稳定产出同一种动效、或把一个效果沉淀成团队模板时使用，产出是格式说明与可复用模板；动效实现走 motion-craft。
descEn: Defines the format convention and field breakdown for motion prompts, with examples of transcribing a reference clip into a prompt. Use it when you want AI to reproduce a motion reliably or to codify an effect as a team template; output is a format spec and reusable templates, not implementation.
outputZh: 提示词格式说明与模板
demoCaptionZh: 排版好的动效提示词模板示例，逐字段标注对象、触发、时长与缓动
demoCaptionEn: Typeset motion prompt templates with annotated subject, trigger, duration and easing fields

taglineZh: 先定设计北极星，再做灰度结构与真实画面评审
taglineEn: Set a design north star, then greybox structure and review real renders
descZh: 一条从产品事实、主角与主动作、灰度线框到实现和独立评审的界面设计主流程，支持多风格同屏对比与基于真实截图的打磨。做新界面、改版或 UI 评审时使用，按请求交付对比页、设计说明、设计稿或可运行界面。
descEn: A mainline UI design flow from product facts, hero and primary action, greybox wireframes to implementation and independent review, with multi-style side-by-side exploration and screenshot-based polish. Use it for new screens, redesigns or UI reviews; delivers comparison pages, design notes, mockups or runnable UI as requested.
outputZh: 对比页、设计说明或可运行界面
outputEn: Comparison page, design notes or runnable UI
demoCaptionZh: 同一张茶室预约卡做成两种风格方向同屏对比：纸感编辑与夜间仪器
demoCaptionEn: One tea-room booking card in two directions side by side: paper editorial vs night instrument

taglineZh: 把参考图和模糊口味拆成可执行的 DESIGN.md
taglineEn: Turn references and vague taste into an executable DESIGN.md
descZh: 把截图、链接或做成这种感觉的参考拆成 Keep/Change/Do-not-copy 三类证据，冻结成一个视觉方向，写出九节 DESIGN.md、决策记录和实现交接。在原型、改版或生图前需要可复用视觉方向时使用，每条主张都可追溯到证据或标注为推断。
descEn: Splits screenshots, URLs or make-it-feel-like-this references into Keep/Change/Do-not-copy evidence, freezes one visual stance, and writes a nine-section DESIGN.md plus a decision record and implementation handoff. Use it before prototypes, redesigns or image remixes when a reusable direction is needed; every claim traces to evidence or a labeled inference.
demoCaptionZh: 参考拆解契约文档示例：证据表、保留与更改边界、九节设计系统索引
demoCaptionEn: A sample design contract: evidence table, keep/change boundaries and the nine-section index

taglineZh: 按十条硬标准审动效代码，默认挑毛病，通过要靠挣
taglineEn: Review motion code against ten hard standards; approval is earned
descZh: 以 Emil Kowalski 的动效哲学为基准审查动画代码：缓动、300ms 时长预算、transform-origin、可打断性、GPU 属性与无障碍，逐条给出 Before/After 修改表和分层结论。审动效合规或修卡顿掉帧时使用，产出是带明确 Block/Approve 判定的审查报告。
descEn: Reviews animation code against Emil Kowalski's motion philosophy: easing, sub-300ms budgets, transform-origin, interruptibility, GPU-only properties and accessibility, with a Before/After fix table and tiered verdict. Use it for motion compliance or jank fixes; output is a review report with an explicit Block/Approve decision.
outputZh: 问题清单与审查判定报告
demoCaptionZh: 动效审查报告示例：Before/After 修改表、分级问题与 Block 判定
demoCaptionEn: A sample motion review: Before/After fix table, tiered findings and a Block verdict

taglineZh: 本地可检索的风格、配色、字体与 UX 规则数据
taglineEn: Locally searchable styles, palettes, type pairings and UX rules
descZh: 把设计决策变成本地数据查询：79 种界面风格、192 套配色、74 组字体搭配和 119 条 UX 规则，零联网。做新页面、定设计系统或查无障碍规范时用脚本检索，产出可落盘复用的 MASTER.md 设计系统与十级优先级自检表。
descEn: Turns design decisions into local data queries: 79 UI styles, 192 product palettes, 74 font pairings and 119 UX rules, fully offline. Use the search script for new pages, design systems or accessibility rules; output is a persistable MASTER.md design system and a ten-tier priority checklist.
outputZh: 设计系统文档与 token 表
demoCaptionZh: 设计系统 token 面板示例：配色、字阶与间距，可切换两套产品方案
demoCaptionEn: A design-system token panel: palette, type scale and spacing, switchable between two product schemes

taglineZh: 九道工序把 vibecoded 界面改成有性格的设计
taglineEn: Nine ordered passes turn vibecoded UI into a designed interface
descZh: 先审计紫色渐变、发光、emoji 标签这些 AI 味信号，从产品本身定方向，再按间距、颜色、图标、文案、字体、布局、细节、视觉、动效九道工序逐层修。功能和内容顺序不动，产出是只属于这个产品的界面和逐工序改造报告。
descEn: Audits the AI tells (purple gradients, glows, emoji labels), derives a direction from the product itself, then fixes spacing, color, icons, copy, type, layout, details, visuals and motion in nine ordered passes. Features and section order stay; output is a screen only this product could have, plus a per-pass report.
outputZh: 改造后的界面与审计报告
demoCaptionZh: 同屏对比 AI 味仪表盘与按九道工序改造后的版本，附信号标注
demoCaptionEn: Side-by-side AI-slop dashboard vs the nine-pass redesign, with tell annotations

taglineZh: 按 Vercel 界面指南逐条审查 UI 代码合规性
taglineEn: Audit UI code against the Vercel Web Interface Guidelines
descZh: 加载 Vercel 团队 Web Interface Guidelines 的固定快照，对指定文件逐条检查布局、排版、颜色、动效与无障碍，输出 file:line 格式的简短发现。交付前想给产品 UI 做一次可复现的合规体检时使用，可选对比上游最新版差异。
descEn: Loads the pinned snapshot of Vercel's Web Interface Guidelines and checks the given files rule by rule across layout, typography, color, motion and accessibility, emitting terse file:line findings. Use it for a reproducible pre-ship compliance pass on product UI, optionally diffing against the live upstream.
demoCaptionZh: 合规审查清单示例：按类别列出通过与未通过项，可筛选未通过
demoCaptionEn: A sample compliance checklist by category with pass/fail items and a fail-only filter
